title: WanderingFollowers1.1 - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 6 NPCs from WanderingFollowers1.1.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by WanderingFollowers1.1 (WanderingFollowers1.1.esp).

Install this if WanderingFollowers1.1.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
